judgment.rationale: The report describes an error after waking and docking, but does not identify which process displayed it or whether the behavior recurs.
evidence: The report names PowerToys 0.95.1.0 from Microsoft Store and three connected displays after a period on battery.
A Windows Update restart notification appeared around the same time; the report does not establish a connection.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for the error text or window title and whether the same sequence still reproduces on current stable.

issue_context.summary: An error appeared after a laptop was powered on at the office and connected to three displays.
known_information: The report describes a wake or power-on event rather than a fresh boot and includes an attachment.
inferences: Display reconfiguration and resume are plausible timing factors, but the error has not been attributed to a PowerToys module.
issue_context.analysis: Identify the window or process before attempting to reproduce the dock sequence. Do not infer causation from the Windows Update notification.
initial_investigation: Read the report and timeline and checked for matching resume-and-docking crash reports. The attachment was not inspected.

information_gaps.information: The error window title or first line and whether this recurs on current stable PowerToys
information_gaps.why_needed: Identifies the failing process and separates one historical occurrence from a current PowerToys regression.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: If it happens again, copy the title or first line without personal details and note whether it appeared before or after plugging in the displays.

fix_assessment.rationale: There is no identified PowerToys failure path or repeatable trigger on which to base a fix.

actions.label: Identify the error shown after waking and docking

comment.body: Thanks for describing the wake and three-display setup. The report doesn't identify which app showed the error. Could you share the error window title or first line, with any personal details removed? If it happens again on current stable PowerToys, please note whether the error appears before or after plugging in the displays. No new attachment is needed.
